key_insight: SwarmEvolve accelerates evolutionary program search by letting hundreds of agents reason and exchange ideas in latent space rather than through lengthy text.
engineering_relevance: Latent-space collaboration offers a promising way to reduce search latency and generation costs for mathematical and scientific computing programs.
method: Run low-cost agent swarms that explore different problem-solving angles.
Select distinct ideas using distances between agents’ hidden-state vectors.
Combine swarm members’ KV caches in a summarizer agent for latent-space crossover.
evidence_signal: Across 21 problems, SwarmEvolve achieved the highest average score and matched competitors’ 60-minute best scores in a reported median of 3–8 minutes.
watch_item: Deployment requires access to model hidden states and KV caches, which may limit compatibility with closed-model APIs.
paper_title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
